title: iGloo distro manifest
description: Schema for distros/<id>/distro.json. Every distribution in the iGloo catalog is described by one of these manifests.

id.description: Catalog identifier. Must match the folder name under distros/.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the picker, e.g. "Fedora KDE".

description.description: One paragraph: who the distro is for and what makes it distinct.

logo.description: Relative path (inside this distro's directory) to a PNG logo, at least 1024px on its longest edge. Rendered as the distro's cover in the 3D picker. Must ship with a NOTICE file carrying source URL and trademark attribution. Forward slashes, no absolute paths, no '..'.

status.description: Catalog availability. "available" requires a working IDistroPlugin in this directory. "coming-soon" entries render in the picker but cannot be installed; use this for catalog entries that do not have a plugin yet.

defaultDesktopEnvironment.description: Desktop environment installed by default, e.g. "KDE Plasma".

installerType.description: Installer technology, e.g. Anaconda | Ubiquity | Calamares | AutoYaST | Subiquity | Custom.

tags.description: Capability/audience tags. iGloo's compatibility rules key off some of these (e.g. secure-boot-supported).

screenshots.description: Relative paths to PNG screenshots inside this distro's directory.
